title: dispatch's return warns when the worker's report names a choice that no gate on its branch records
goal: when a dispatched worker exits, dispatch compares the report's named choices (a 'gate not recorded' or 'choice' line) with the gates on work/<id> and prints a warning naming each unrecorded one, so the orchestrator resumes the worker before the landing instead of finding it by reading

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, re, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
def bench(*a):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
s = open('_tools/bl_dispatch.py', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert re.search(r'not recorded|unrecorded', s), 'dispatch does not read the report for unrecorded choices'

notes: SP-7s6uubs7 close: BG-lyifmguf's worker wrote 'Gate not recorded' for two choices; one resume recorded them. The check reads source only.
